profile.name: Vijay

profile.bioHeadline: Hi, I'm Vijay Prajapati. Building High-Performance Web & Mobile Apps.

projects.title: GoldCart — Digital Gold & Silver Investment App
projects.description: Production-ready mobile application for digital gold and silver investment, featuring live metal prices, buying/selling, portfolio management, SIP/savings plans, KYC, and redemption workflows.
projects.longDescription: Developed and deployed a full-fledged cross-platform fintech mobile application engineered for digital gold and silver investments. Features live metal price ticker integrations, instant buy/sell mechanics, systematic investment plan (SIP) recurring savings schemes, comprehensive user portfolio valuation, transaction histories, and seamless KYC verification with doorstep metal redemption delivery.
highlights: Live gold and silver spot price feeds with real-time portfolio valuation
Automated SIP (Systematic Investment Plans) & recurring savings modules
Secure end-to-end KYC verification, profile management, and OTP authentication
Full digital gold/silver buying, selling, and physical bullion redemption workflows
Deployed and maintained on Google Play Store and Apple App Store

projects.title: Digi Jewels — Digital Gold & Silver Platform
projects.description: Mobile application with features for digital gold/silver purchase, sell, and redemption, portfolio tracking, KYC verification, transaction history, and account management deployed to both app stores.
projects.longDescription: Engineered a robust digital metals trading and investment platform on React Native. Implemented user-facing features including live gold/silver rates, digital investment portfolios, transaction history, SIP/savings plans, KYC verification, redemption, and account management with responsive Figma-to-code implementations.
highlights: Integrated live rate calculation engine for 24K 999 gold and 999 silver
Automated KYC documentation and bank account verification workflows
Detailed transaction logs, invoice generation, and historical performance charts
Successfully deployed and maintained on both Google Play Store and Apple App Store

projects.title: Mayur Jewellers — Digital Investment App
projects.description: Mobile application for digital gold/silver investment and jewellery-related services, implementing reusable UI components, API integrations, investment workflows, and user accounts.
projects.longDescription: Developed the branded mobile application for Mayur Jewellers bridging digital bullion savings with retail jewellery services. Created modular UI components using TypeScript and Tailwind CSS/NativeWind, integrated secure payment and transaction workflows, managed server-side state with React Query, and handled release signing and store deployments.
highlights: Reusable TypeScript UI component system built directly from Figma designs
Integrated payment gateways and transaction workflows for metal purchases
Form validation with React Hook Form and error boundary handling
Release configuration, signing, and production deployment across Android & iOS

projects.title: Priyadarshi Jewells — Gold & Silver Savings App
projects.description: Production mobile application supporting gold/silver SIPs, savings schemes, portfolio management, redemption, and transaction-related workflows.
projects.longDescription: Engineered a production-ready mobile application enabling retail customers to start micro-savings in 24K pure gold and silver. Implemented flexible daily/monthly SIP schemes, portfolio tracking with live valuation updates, KYC onboarding, secure OTP login, and physical store redemption workflows.
highlights: Gold and silver micro-savings scheme with flexible installment intervals
Dynamic portfolio analytics showing unrealized gains and investment trends
Robust REST API integrations with Axios, error handling, and loading skeletons
Streamlined Google Play Store & iOS App Store production builds

projects.title: Huzzle App
projects.description: Cross-platform mobile application developed for Android and iOS using React Native. Contributed to core features, custom reusable UI components, and supported deployment on both mobile platforms.
projects.longDescription: Production mobile application built with React Native and TypeScript, engineered for seamless performance across both Android and iOS devices. Developed modular UI components from Figma prototypes, implemented smooth screen navigation via React Navigation, integrated backend REST APIs and Firebase services, and supported the deployment lifecycle on Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
highlights: Contributed to core product features and custom modular UI components
Implemented seamless application routing using React Navigation
Integrated Firebase Authentication and cloud backend services
Supported deployment to both Google Play Store and iOS App Store

projects.title: Aeon Pass — Multi-App Suite
projects.description: Multi-app ecosystem featuring Guest and Gatekeeper mobile apps for secure entry management, paired with a Next.js Web Admin Panel for visitor control and real-time analytics.
projects.longDescription: Comprehensive access control solution spanning mobile clients and an enterprise administrative panel. Engineered two specialized mobile applications (Guest App and Gatekeeper App) using React Native (Expo) for visitor pass creation, QR scanning, and OTP verification. Built the Next.js Web Admin Panel with Tailwind CSS for security administrators to oversee real-time facility check-ins, visitor logs, and permissions.
highlights: Built Guest and Gatekeeper dual mobile apps focused on secure entry management
Engineered the responsive Next.js Web Admin Panel with admin controls and analytics
Implemented Firebase Auth with Email/Password and OTP verification flows
Designed pixel-accurate responsive interfaces directly from Figma specifications

projects.title: Orange App
projects.description: Android application built with Flutter featuring offline data synchronization, optimized for seamless operation in low-connectivity environments.
projects.longDescription: Robust Android client engineered with Flutter and Dart, specifically designed to function reliably in field scenarios with intermittent or zero internet connectivity. Implemented offline local caching mechanisms, automatic sync on network restoration, fluid screen transitions with Flutter Navigator, and robust RESTful API integration.
highlights: Offline-first data synchronization engine for low-connectivity environments
Clean, responsive UI developed with Flutter native Material widgets
Screen routing and workflow navigation via Flutter Navigator
REST API data consumption, serialization, and error handling
